descricao_original: The epithelium of lining mucosa is stratified squamous moist; epithelial pegs (ridges) are short. The lamina propria in the oral cavity, like the dermis of the skin, is subdivided into a papillary portion immediately beneath the epithelium and a reticular portion of denser connective tissue. The submucosa, underlying the mucosa, contains minor salivary glands. 200x
creditos_identificados: Image source: This image was taken of a slide from the University of Michigan collection.
